Questions Before You Buy

Is this a live jar or a dried pouch?

A dried pouch. It's shelf-stable until you wake it up, so it ships like any dry good and keeps in a drawer until you're ready.

Do I need a scale or special equipment?

No. A glass jar, flour, filtered water and a spoon. Every step on the pouch is measured in tablespoons.

What if it doesn't bubble?

Not bubbling by day 7? Send us a photo and we'll ship a fresh packet, free. Ordered on Amazon? Message us from Your Orders.

How long does one pouch last?

Years, if you keep feeding it. Keep it on the counter with a daily feed, or in the fridge with a weekly one. The discard from feedings makes pancakes, crackers and pizza dough.

Who makes it?

KozyKraft, a brand of Kozy Kraft LLC. It's made in small batches in Ohio, and every batch is tested before it's dried. Questions: contact us.

Shipping and returns?

Handled by Amazon.com under Amazon's shipping and return policies. Delivery estimates show on the Amazon listing before you order.

Easy gift for the baker in your life: it fits in a stocking.
